MainWindow.Title: Scanline Studio
MainWindow.StatusBar.TxInhibit.Help: Lit when the last transmit attempt ended in an error or an automatic SWR cutoff -- does not persistently block a new Transmit.
MainWindow.StatusBar.TxKeyed.Help: Live PTT state read back from the connected rig. Requires a CAT link and a rig that reports PTT state (not all VOX/DTR-keyed rigs do) -- without both, this can't confirm whether the rig is actually keyed.
RadioStatus.Tune.Help: Keys PTT and transmits a steady test tone at the given frequency/duration so the other station's AFC/tuning indicator can lock on -- does not send an image.
RadioStatus.Error.NoRadioConnected: No radio connected -- configure CAT control in Options first.
RadioStatus.Error.TuneFailed: Tune failed. Check your radio and audio device settings.
RadioStatus.Error.ReceivingFailed: Could not start/stop receiving. Check your audio device settings.
RadioStatus.Error.SavePresetsFailed: Could not save the frequency preset.
RadioStatus.Warning.RxMaintenanceApproac: RX has been continuously active for a long time without a pause -- it will restart automatically once idle, or be force-stopped soon if it never idles.
RadioStatus.Error.RxMaintenanceRequired: RX was stopped for required internal maintenance. Click Receiving to resume.
RadioStatus.FavouritesHint: Click a preset to recall it
RadioStatus.ReceivingPausedForTx.Help: Capture is briefly paused while transmitting -- listening resumes automatically once the transmission finishes.
Panes.RxImage.ModeOverride.Help: The decoder always auto-detects mode from the VIS header. There is no persistent mode lock -- use a quick-mode button below to force the next decode into a specific mode.
Panes.RxImage.LockedMode.Help: No persistent mode lock exists -- use a quick-mode button below to force the next decode into a specific mode.
Panes.RxFrameMeta.Error.EntryNoLongerExi: This entry no longer exists -- it may have aged out of history.
Panes.RxHistory.Error.EntryNoLongerExist: This entry no longer exists -- it may have aged out of history.

Panes.TxControls.Error.LoadFailed: Could not load that image file.
Panes.TxControls.Error.TransmitFailed: Transmission failed. Check your radio and audio device settings.
Panes.TxControls.Error.SwrCutoff: Transmission stopped automatically: SWR too high.
Panes.TxControls.SwrCutoffEnabled: Stop TX if SWR too high
Panes.TxControls.SwrCutoffEnabled.Help: Requires SWR meter support from your connected radio/backend -- disabled until a rig reporting SWR is connected.
Panes.TxImageEditor.LockAspectToMode.Hel: Constrains the crop rectangle to the selected mode's own aspect ratio. Combine with Preserve aspect OFF to fill the frame edge-to-edge with no distortion and no letterboxing.
Panes.TxImageEditor.NoQsoFields: No template fields in this layout yet.
Panes.TxImageEditor.NoElementSelected: Select an element to edit its geometry.
Panes.TxImageEditor.Caption: Preview shows crop/scale/overlay placement only -- does not simulate per-mode color/chroma effects.
Panes.TxImageEditor.SnapGrid.Help: Snap the selected element to a 5% grid when you release a drag or resize.
Panes.TxImageEditor.AdjustmentsNonDestru: Adjustments are non-destructive and stored with the template.
Panes.TxImageEditor.NoTextSelected: Select a text element to edit its style
Panes.TxImageEditor.FontUnavailableWarni: This font isn't bundled with the app — the transmitted image will use the default font instead.
Panes.TxImageEditor.ConfirmCancelDiscard: Unsaved edits will be lost — click Cancel again to discard them.
Panes.TxImageEditor.ConfirmRecallOverwri: This layout has unsaved edits — select the same template again to load it and discard them.
Panes.TxImageEditor.LoadTemplateFailed: Couldn't load that template. Check the log for details.
Panes.TxImageEditor.SaveTemplateFailed: Couldn't save this template. Check the log for details.
Panes.TxImageEditor.AddImageFailed: Couldn't add that image. Check the log for details.
Panes.TxImageEditor.DeleteTemplateFailed: Couldn't delete that template. Check the log for details.

Panes.TxImageEditor.RxHistoryPickerRefre: Couldn't refresh the RX history picker. Check the log for details.

Options.Title: Options
Options.ResetAll.ConfirmPrompt: This resets every setting below to its default. Nothing is saved until you click Save, but this can't be undone within this dialog. Continue?
Options.Audio.SampleRate.Help: Whole-Hz DSP rate from 5000 to 48500. Decoder, waterfall, capture, and playback use one rate for the process lifetime; restart Scanline Studio after changing it. 11025 Hz is the legacy default.
Options.Radio.Backend.Help: How Scanline Studio talks to your radio. 'None' disables frequency/mode/PTT control entirely. 'rigctld' connects to an already-running Hamlib rigctld process (or compatible), which can control almost any rig Hamlib supports. 'Linked Hamlib' talks to a system-installed libhamlib directly, no separate daemon process needed, but requires libhamlib to actually be installed on this machine.
Options.Radio.Connect.Help: Connects (or disconnects) the app's real radio session using your SAVED settings above -- click Save first if you just changed them. Takes effect immediately, no restart needed.
Options.Radio.Hamlib.LibraryPath.Help: Path to a specific Hamlib shared library file. Leave blank to let Scanline Studio search the usual system locations for it. Takes effect after restarting Scanline Studio.
Options.Radio.Hamlib.Probe.FoundNoModels: Found Hamlib {0} at {1}, but could not list its rig models. Enter the rig model number manually below.
Options.Radio.Hamlib.RigList.Placeholder: Browse or auto-detect Hamlib above to list its rig models
Options.Radio.Hamlib.Model.Help: Hamlib's own numeric rig model ID (rig_model_t) -- look it up with 'rigctl -l' or Hamlib's own rig list. There is no Scanline Studio rig database; this must be Hamlib's own model number.
Options.Radio.Hamlib.SerialPort.Help: The serial device your rig is connected to for CAT control, e.g. /dev/ttyUSB0 on Linux or COM3 on Windows.
Options.Radio.Hamlib.PttType.Help: How Scanline Studio keys your transmitter. VOX: no command is sent at all -- your rig's own hardware VOX keys on audio presence. CAT: keyed over the same CAT connection as frequency/mode control. RTS/DTR: keyed by asserting a serial control line, using the PTT port below.
Options.Radio.Hamlib.PttPort.Help: The serial device that keys PTT via RTS/DTR -- separate from the CAT serial port above, since some setups use a dedicated PTT cable/adapter. Only used for the RTS/DTR PTT methods.
Options.Radio.Hamlib.TestPtt.VoxDisabled: Keys PTT for up to 5 seconds so you can confirm it actually keys your rig (an LED, a relay click). Disabled for VOX, since Hamlib sends no command at all for it -- there's nothing to test; the rig keys itself on audio presence.
Options.Radio.Hamlib.AlreadyConnected: Disconnect the active radio connection first -- a test can't run alongside it.
Options.Radio.Tune.Help: Keys PTT and transmits a steady test tone for up to 30 seconds -- drag Pwr while it plays and watch your radio's own power meter until it reads the output you want, then click Stop tune (or wait for the 30s safety cutoff).
Options.Tx.Callsign.Help: Your own callsign. Used in the TX overlay editor's %m macro token ("MY CALL" insert-field chip) and QSO log export. CW-ID still doesn't exist yet -- harmless to leave blank until it does.
Options.NotImplemented.Help: Not yet implemented -- tracked on the roadmap. This control is disabled and has no effect yet.
Options.General.JpegQuality.Help: 1-100 JPEG compression quality used when manually exporting a received frame as JPEG (Gallery tab's Export button). Received images are always auto-saved as PNG regardless of this setting -- it only applies when you choose JPEG in the export dialog.
Options.General.ColorsHeader.Help: Legacy let you pick a color for each waterfall/spectrum element individually. The new flat design has one fixed palette; per-element color customization isn't available.
Options.Audio.StereoSource.Help: Which channel to decode from when the capture device is stereo -- mono mixes both, Left/Right uses only that channel (useful when RX and a second signal share one stereo input).
Options.Audio.StereoTx: Send TX audio to both stereo channels separately
Options.Radio.Backend.OmniRig.Help: Talks to an already-running OmniRig instance as a client, letting Scanline Studio share the rig with another OmniRig-aware application (e.g. a logger). Speculative -- not yet designed, see spec/03-cat-layer.md.
Options.Radio.Backend.FlRig.Help: Talks to an already-running flrig instance as a client over its XML-RPC interface. Design deferred, see spec/03-cat-layer.md.
Options.Radio.PttLock.Help: Keeps PTT asserted continuously instead of only during an active transmit -- a diagnostic/manual-keying aid, not normal operation.
Options.Decode.SenseLevel.Help: How strong a signal needs to be before the decoder treats it as real SSTV rather than noise. Higher = less sensitive, fewer false decodes on a noisy band.
Options.Decode.RxBpf.Help: How tightly the receiver band-pass filters incoming audio before demodulation. Normal disables this band-pass filter entirely. Wide is the recommended default. Sharp and Very sharp reject more adjacent-tone interference at the cost of more sensitivity to frequency drift. Takes effect after restarting.
Options.Decode.DemodType.Help: Which FM discriminator algorithm decodes the audio. Hilbert transform matches legacy's own shipped default. PLL and zero crossing are real, selectable alternatives; PLL is also always used internally for AVT training regardless of this setting. Takes effect after restarting.
Options.Decode.RxBuffer.Help: Stages decoded picture lines so a later sample-rate/sync correction (Auto Slant, or a manual Correct Slant) can redraw already-received lines without re-decoding from scratch. Off disables this entirely -- no correction ever redraws past lines, and Auto Slant is unavailable. On keeps the buffer in memory, bounded by available RAM. Extended stores it on disk instead, with no practical size cap but real disk I/O cost -- best for long or marginal-signal receptions. Takes effect after restarting.
Options.Decode.AutoStart.Help: Automatically begin recording as soon as a sync pulse is detected, instead of requiring a manual start.
Options.Decode.AutoRestart: Restart onto a stronger sync mid-reception
Options.Identification.SoundFile.Help: A recorded audio file played instead of a CW-keyed tone for identification -- legacy's own .mmv sound-file ID, not a picture/image ID.
Options.Identification.NrRstEnabled: Send NR/RST sub-packet with FSK ID
Options.Identification.NrRstTextWatermar: e.g. 599123 (static value, not a live QSO exchange)
Options.Identification.TuneSatellite: Switch to transmit after tune timer (satellite mode)
Options.Identification.TuneSatellite.Hel: After the tune tone's duration elapses, automatically switch to transmit instead of receive -- for satellite passes where TX should follow immediately.
Options.Advanced.Caption: Deep DSP tuning and diagnostics, ported from legacy's own Option dialog. None of these are wired to real behavior yet -- see the roadmap.
Options.Advanced.PllHeader.Help: Internal filter parameters for the PLL-based FM discriminator (used for AVT modes today).
Options.Advanced.CrossingHeader.Help: Internal filter parameters for the zero-crossing discriminator -- this demodulator type isn't ported at all yet (see the Decode tab).
Options.Advanced.TxSampleClockOffset.Hel: Fine trim for TX audio sample-clock drift relative to the nominal sample rate, compensating for sound-card clock inaccuracy.
Options.Qrz.QrzLookupPasswordHint: Stored locally, unencrypted -- consider using a unique password for this account rather than one reused elsewhere.
Options.Forwarding.Description: Every logged QSO is sent to each enabled destination below over UDP, using the WSJT-X network protocol's LoggedADIF message -- the same message GridTracker, N1MM Logger+, and Log4OM already know how to receive. Common ports: GridTracker 2237, N1MM Logger+ / Log4OM 2333.
Options.Forwarding.EmptyHint: No destinations configured -- add one to start forwarding.
Panes.Logbook.NoEntriesYet: No QSOs match the current search.
Panes.Logbook.Error.UpdateFailed: Could not save changes to that QSO.
Panes.Logbook.Error.ImportPartial: Import failed partway through -- some rows above may already have been added.
Panes.Logbook.Error.ExportFailed: Could not export to that file.
